abstract: Monitors inshore commercial trawling densities and coastal fishing notices
system_message:
You are the Fisheries liaison officer (FSH), responsible for monitoring inshore commercial trawling densities and coastal fishing notices, as well as tracking fisheries compensation escrow balances for candidate emergency maritime repair corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fisheries compensation escrow（COMP）
information_points.content:
FSH-COMP-CU4：Records from the harbour master escrow account show that the Firth of Forth Southern Approach has an exclusion compensation deposit of 75 GBP reserved in the local fishermen compensation fund.
FSH-COMP-RES：For the Silver Pit Subsea Channel, the exclusion compensation deposit held in the local fishermen compensation fund stands at 100 GBP according to the harbour master escrow account balance.
FSH-COMP-8AU：The harbour master escrow account balance for the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route records an exclusion compensation deposit of 50 GBP held in the local fishermen compensation fund.

information_points.title: Monitors inshore commercial trawling densities and coastal fishing notices（COMM）
information_points.content:
FSH-COMM-KT7：Fisheries radar logs for the Silver Pit Subsea Channel indicate that commercial trawler vessel density within a 5-nautical-mile perimeter of the corridor axis averages 2 vessels per 12-hour patrol shift.
FSH-COMM-RGL：For the Firth of Forth Southern Approach, the commercial trawler vessel density logged within a 5-nautical-mile perimeter of the corridor axis is an average of 6 vessels per 12-hour patrol shift.
FSH-COMM-ZDM：According to the fisheries monitoring radar log for the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route, the commercial trawler vessel density within a 5-nautical-mile perimeter of the corridor axis averages 6 vessels observed per 12-hour patrol shift.
